reviews.title: Good product, good price
reviews.comment: I had never heard of the brand but it was on sale for a great price for what it is and I'm really happy with it, it's got a great picture , it's steady on it's stand and it works great with games .
reviews.author: erica potts

reviews.title: Perfect for gaming
reviews.comment: Love this monitor, works perfect for my dual monitor setup. Curve is great if you’ve never had a curved monitor you gotta try it. Colors and blacks look beautiful. Perfect for my price range.
reviews.author: Ash H

reviews.title: Incredible Value for the Performance
reviews.comment: Fantastic display! The curvature makes a marked improvement to the screen size. Additionally, games look so smooth and are far more immersive! It plugged in simply, and auto detected the inputs as I powered them on! Finally, the cost for the quality is such that Imm giving serious consideration to buying a second one!
reviews.author: Teh Naiche

reviews.title: Excellent buy
reviews.comment: Showed up well packaged. Unpacking and setting up was very easy. True 34" corner to corner size. The color clarity and refresh rate is exceptional. Great quality. Value for money is awesome Functionality is superb. Sound quality is nonexistent because this is a monitor, not a tv so idk why amazon wants a rating on that. Anyway. This fits my setup exactly how I was expecting and I'm really pleased with it. Automatically goes into sleep mode when I power down my laptop which is nice in case I forget to turn it off.
reviews.author: Taylor
